payload.friendly_name: Docsite on DocKitty 0.6.0 and pack-ecosystem diagrams
payload.purpose_context: The docsite still builds on DocKitty 0.5.0 although 0.6.0 (API reference pages from OpenAPI files, schema pages) shipped on 2026-11-02, and the PlantUML architecture diagrams still draw the pack model that ADR-0048 to ADR-0052 (accepted 2026-11-02) change. Readers should see current tooling and diagrams that match the decided pack ecosystem.
payload.purpose_tldr: Move the docsite to DocKitty 0.6.0 and redraw the architecture diagrams for the accepted pack-ecosystem decisions.

options: Keep the current-state diagrams and add separate decided-design diagrams beside them
Redraw the existing diagrams to the decided design, replacing today's picture
One diagram set that draws today plus the decided changes marked as not built yet
payload.question: The architecture pages and their diagrams describe what the code does today, and none of ADR-0048 to ADR-0052 is built yet. How should the diagrams reflect the accepted design?

payload.final_answer: Redraw the existing diagrams to the decided design, replacing today's picture

options: OpenAPI reference pages for the charter contract and Schematic pages for the pack schemas
Version bump only; adopt features later
payload.question: Which DocKitty 0.6.0 capabilities should the docsite adopt in this mission beyond the version bump?

payload.final_answer: OpenAPI reference pages for the charter contract and Schematic pages for the pack schemas

options: Keep browser rendering; Schematic pages without the diagram
Switch to build-time rendering with the pinned PlantUML service
payload.question: Schematic pages only draw their schema diagram when the docsite renders diagrams at build time against a PlantUML service; the docsite renders in the browser today, so the diagram section is left out. Should the docsite switch to build-time rendering?

payload.final_answer: Switch to build-time rendering with the pinned PlantUML service

payload.wp_title: Diagram toolchain and the pack-composition diagrams
Page text around the diagrams, and the changelog
Charter API reference and pack schema pages
